title: devexp-standup-2026-07-08
content:
Attendees: Ava Chen, Samir Patel, Leah Gomez, Ethan Brooks, Priya Nair (brief), Jason Li (joined for SDK discussion)

Date: 2026-07-08
Sprint week: 2026-07-06 - 2026-07-10

Summary/High level
- Focus this week: finalize Python SDK 1.4.0 beta for internal testing, land quickstart guide for hosted API (node + python), and triage docs infra flakiness reported in last release.
- Small samples refresh: add streaming/chat example for Ruby and Go (community requests).

Updates by owner
- Ava (SDK + releases):
  - Cut release candidate branch for python-sdk v1.4.0. Release notes draft is up at GH-PR-5589.
  - Main changes: streaming support (async iterator), improved typed responses for function calling, and better error classification (retryable vs fatal).
  - Blocker: one failing integration test around streaming reconnects on flaky CI nodes. Repro locally intermittent; need to reproduce on dedicated infra. Requesting help from infra team to pin down flakiness.
  - Action: will open a focused ticket and assign to infra SRE by EOD.

- Samir (Docs + quickstarts):
  - Hosted API quickstart draft complete for Node + Python. Includes sample env var setup, minimal request, streaming example, and common troubleshooting.
  - Need a short demo script (30s) for the community webinar next Tuesday. Leah volunteered to record.
  - Found formatting issue in sidebar rendering for large code blocks on mobile; filing ticket CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-423 for docs team to patch.

- Leah (Samples + examples):
  - Added Ruby streaming sample and prototype Go client sample using grpc-for-streaming shim. Samples are lightweight and under samples/streaming-examples.
  - Plan to run sample smoke tests in staging; will create a matrix job to run against latest python-sdk-rc.

- Ethan (Quickstarts + onboarding flows):
  - Updated quickstart checklist to include KMS notes for Private deployments. Need confirmation from security on recommended KMS patterns (Priya to follow up).
  - Onboarding flow metrics: signup->first-request conversion dipped 3% last week after docs search change. Hypothesis: new search results surface too many advanced pages. Samir to evaluate search snippets.

- Priya (Security - joined briefly):
  - Confirmed KMS pattern for private customers: recommend envelope encryption + customer-managed keys. Will provide short blurb for quickstart.

Blockers / Help needed
- Streaming integration test flakiness (Ava): infra assistance to reproduce and capture logs for failing CI node.
- Docs mobile rendering bug (Samir): front-end docs engineer to triage CSS overflow in sidebar.
- Signup->first-request metric drop (Ethan/Samir): product analytics help to run funnel breakdown by cohort and search experiment flag.

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Ava: Open infra ticket for streaming test flake and attach failing builds/logs (due 2026-07-08).
- Samir: Finalize quickstart for hosted API and link to samples, publish as draft to Confluence for review (due 2026-07-09).
- Leah: Add staging smoke job for streaming samples and run nightly (due 2026-07-10).
- Ethan: Coordinate with product analytics to run funnel breakdown (due 2026-07-09).
- Priya: Provide KMS blurb for quickstart and add to PR (due 2026-07-09).

Risks/Notes
- If streaming CI flake persists, block on shipping python-sdk 1.4.0 GA; may need to roll back streaming changes to avoid delaying release. Discuss rollback threshold by tomorrow standup.
- Community webinar demo must be recorded by 2026-07-12 to allow edits; Leah + Samir to coordinate.

Decisions made
- Proceed with python-sdk RC publishing for internal QA while keeping GA gated on CI stability.
- Add small note in quickstart about KMS recommendation for private deployments (non-blocking).

Parking lot / Future work
- Add a short interactive playground in docs where users can enter a prompt and see streaming behavior (post-release Q3).
- Explore making sample repo templates for Ruby/Go/Java to simplify community contribution.

Meeting notes / misc
- Jason Li joined to discuss SDK ergonomics: agreed to keep async iterator shape and add a sync helper for simple use-cases. Jason to file ergonomics PR with examples (GH-PR-5598).
- Quick mention: grace period for deprecating old client config (client.v1) extended to end of Q3 to give customers time to migrate.

Next standup: 2026-07-15 10:00am PT

Attachments / links referenced:
- GH-PR-5589 (python-sdk release candidate)
- CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-423 (docs mobile bug)
- JIRA-EXP-1623 (signup funnel investigation)

Notes to self (informal):
- Remember to update changelog with streaming caveats re: reconnect behavior.
- Consider adding small test harness script that simulates flaky network for streaming tests.
